name: Interchange
summary: A site menu drawn as a metro map: pick a station and a little train rides the lines to that page
about: The pages of a design festival site are stations on three coloured lines that meet at two interchanges. Hover a station to see the route and the number of stops; pick it and the doors close, the train pulls away, lights up the track behind it, pings every station it passes, brakes with a little spring and opens its doors while the platform sign rolls and the page rises in. On small screens the map pans to follow the train.
how: Click or tap any station, or Tab to one and press Enter, to ride there.
Use the arrow keys to move between stations in that direction on the map.
Press Plan, Meet or Help to highlight one line; press it again to show all.
On Tickets, pick a pass and change the number to see the total in PKR.
A demo tour plays by itself until you click, tap or press a key.
